coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters, drawn rules, rectangles and cells (cand/b106.json); tick boxes are drawn squares; row cells measured between row rules from caption to caption; every page looked at at 80 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: broker-dealer, financial advisor and branch manager (pages 6-7)
signing.kind: Subscription agreement form (Cohen & Steers Income Opportunities REIT). The investor completes sections 1-5, 7-9, initials the representations with a second (joint) box beside each, and signs page A-13 with a co-investor/custodian beside; the broker-dealer section and signatures are on A-6/A-7. No issuer acceptance block.
